source.quote_free_summary: The hired Scoring System must produce awards reports to be read to the public, and only this report can be used for Awards; results cannot be re-written to another document to unveil placements.

requirement: A UCWDC profile must produce the awards report from the sanctioned scoring system; DanceFlow Studio output must never be offered as the official awards report.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. A PROFILE-ACTIVATION BLOCKER for the named body. Docs-only record; no compliance claimed. Not authorized: engine, SQL, UI, report generation.
interpretation_notes: 'Hired Scoring Systems, vetted to use UCWDC Majority Rules' is a UCWDC authorization DanceFlow does not hold. Manually produced external reports are NOT an automatic compliance bypass: any external-report workflow needs separate documented verification and authorization.
decision_refs: OD-23 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B for initial Studio/Custom; Option A required for future body profiles; retrospective audit PR #795)
